departments.name: Electrical & Power Systems
departments.description: Residential and commercial electrical repairs, wiring, breaker fixes, and power installations.

departments.name: Plumbing & Pipe Fitting
departments.description: Emergency leak repair, bathroom fixtures, drain clearance, pipe routing, and sanitary fittings.

departments.name: HVAC & Air Conditioning
departments.description: Air conditioning servicing, gas refills, deep coil cleaning, heating, and duct maintenance.

departments.name: Home Appliances Repair
departments.description: Washing machine, refrigerator, microwave oven, and kitchen appliance diagnostics & repair.

departments.name: Carpentry & Woodwork
departments.description: Custom furniture repair, locks, doors, hinges, modular fittings, and interior woodwork.

services.name: Ceiling Fan Installation & Repair
services.description: Full diagnostic check, capacitor replacement, mounting, or new fan installation.

services.name: Complete Switchboard Diagnostic & Rewiring
services.description: Short circuit inspection, MCB replacement, and heavy appliance socket installation.

services.name: Emergency Water Leak & Tap Replacement
services.description: High pressure leakage fix, washer replacement, tap mounting, and angle valve renewal.

services.name: Deep Drain Unclogging & Jet Clean
services.description: Drain snakes and organic solvent clearing for kitchen sinks and bathroom lines.

services.name: Split AC Foam Jet Deep Service
services.description: Indoor and outdoor unit pressure foam cleaning, filter sanitation, and airflow testing.

services.name: AC Gas Leak Detection & Top-up
services.description: Nitrogen pressure testing, brazing of pinhole leaks, and eco refrigerant charging.

services.name: Refrigerator Cooling Diagnostic & Repair
services.description: Compressor relay check, thermostat adjustment, defrost timer, and coil maintenance.

services.name: Door Lock Repair & Handle Fitting
services.description: Precision mortise lock replacement, latch adjustments, and hinge lubrication.
